summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms per the spec, without running tests, linters, or repository code, and without committing. Changes: (1) monai/transforms/utility/array.py: appended Lambda(Transform) with an assert "func must be callable" in __init__ and __call__ returning self.func(img). (2) monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import changed to "Callable, Optional" (Optional is still used by DataStatsd); added Lambda to the array import; added Lambdad(MapTransform) between ConcatItemsd and the alias block, with __init__(keys, func) calling super().__init__ first and building one internal Lambda; appended LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad. IdentityD line untouched. (3) docs/source/transforms.rst: Lambda section before SplitChannel; Lambdad section after ConcatItemsd and before Transform Adaptors. (4) tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py: identity and slicing cases on NumpyImageTestCase2D, with license header and main guard. Flake8 and black compliance, and test results, are unverified because nothing was run.
